Metadata.title: Your Next.js App
Metadata.description: A clean, multilingual Next.js starter built with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.

Home.headline: Build something great.
Home.description: Your Next.js starter is running. It includes TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, language switching, and light/dark mode — without accounts or configuration.
Home.featureSpeedText: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS with a small, understandable codebase.
Home.featureI18nText: Real localized routes and translations, including right-to-left layouts.
Home.featureThemeText: A working color theme toggle with system preference support.
Home.nextStepText: Replace this page, update the app name, and add your own routes and components. No API keys or external service required.
Home.tip: Your changes appear automatically during npm run dev.
Home.previewSubtitle: Your first workspace is one click away
Home.highlightsLabel: Everything you need, nothing you don't
Home.highlightsSubtitle: A clean starting point designed to grow with your product.
Home.bottomDescription: A real interactive workspace and a guided tour are already included. Explore them, then replace the examples with your product.

Workspace.title: A workspace you can actually use.
Workspace.description: Keep your work moving: search, prioritize, sort, and manage tasks in a real interactive workspace.
Workspace.demoDisclaimer: Your tasks stay in this browser, not in the cloud. Use Export backup to take a copy with you.
Workspace.storageUnavailable: Browser storage unavailable — changes last only until you reload.
Workspace.placeholder: What would you like to work on?
Workspace.emptyHint: Add a task above or choose another filter.
Workspace.limitReached: Maximum 100 tasks. Remove some to add more.
Workspace.clearConfirm: Delete {count} completed tasks? This cannot be undone.
Workspace.invalidImport: This file is not a valid workspace backup.
Workspace.importConfirm: Replace your current tasks with {count} imported tasks?
Workspace.invalidSavedData: Saved workspace data is invalid; it has not been overwritten. You can import a valid backup.

Guide.title: From fresh install to your own product.
Guide.description: The important files are easy to find, and everything works without a database or an external API.
Guide.firstDescription: Replace the landing page, add sections, and make the responsive layout your own.
Guide.secondDescription: Edit English and Persian messages; add languages later through the routing configuration.
Guide.thirdDescription: Explore the sample task workspace for an example of components, typed state, filters and local persistence.
Guide.commandsHint: Use these commands inside your new project folder. The starter includes a working application as well as a clear place to add your own routes.

Errors.notFoundDescription: The link may have moved. Head back to your workspace or the overview.
Errors.unexpectedDescription: An unexpected error occurred. You can retry or return to the overview.
